create_faulty_tensorpipe_backend: create a FAULTY_TENSORPIPE RPC backend using FaultyTensorPipeRpcBackendOptions with configurable failure injection parameters
test_faulty_tensorpipe_construct: test the _faulty_tensorpipe_construct_rpc_backend_options_handler to build FaultyTensorPipeRpcBackendOptions with rpc_timeout, init_method, and failure injection settings
test_faulty_tensorpipe_init_backend: test the _faulty_tensorpipe_init_backend_handler to initialize a FaultyTensorPipeAgent with a c10d Store and FaultyTensorPipeRpcBackendOptions
test_backend_registry_registration: test registering the FAULTY_TENSORPIPE backend with rpc.backend_registry using construct and init backend handlers
run_faulty_agent_injection: run a FAULTY_TENSORPIPE agent that injects message failures and delays into PyTorch distributed RPC communication
